mentions.name: Tenjin
mentions.description: Tenjin is a knowledge layer for AI agents so they stop duplicating work. It rides Claude Code/Codex hooks to capture useful information and injects it when needed (such as when an error occurs) for other agents. Knowledge is shared across a team and a global marketplace layer with incentives for contributions. It is currently being benchmarked with an aim of 10% token reduction, and preliminary design partners are being accepted.
mentions.problem: AI agents duplicate work because there is no shared knowledge layer between them.
mentions.audience: Teams of developers using AI coding agents
